scope: Research probe only; planar torso plus two point feet. No World integration, calibration, or readiness claim.

priors.pushImpulse: push_recovery = 0.75 * runner.mass in +x; held_step = 0.45 * runner.mass * strength in +x; sign mirrors with transform
priors.pushForce: known torso force = push impulse / 0.01 s, integrated by advanceInertialGaits; same total impulse at every dt
priors.power: locomotorPowerPrior(profile, body) = legForce * max(vmax, stepSpeed); broad explicit actuator prior, not fitted

omitted: Full time series, per-landing lists and duplicate per-case work/phase/pulse details stay in out; retained rows, all triplet statuses/comparisons, aggregate ledgers, phase totals and per-case peak contexts cover every case. See raw hashes and reproduction commands.
